title: Why My Rock-Paper-Scissors Project Became a Dice Roller
excerpt: The Odin Project has you build Rock Paper Scissors as a course project. I ended up pointing that same logic at a dice roller instead.

title: The Course Calculator That Became a Jobsite Tool
excerpt: The Odin Project's Calculator project just wants a working four function calculator. Mine kept growing until it turned into GlovesOn, a concrete calculator I actually use on the job.
